# Result

`schemas/records/result.json`

One immutable output of a node (docs/design/m0/13 "Model" [G1]). A result is never overwritten. Which result a computation key has selected is recorded by the graph events (G3), not here. The controller computes the outcome from observed facts (13 "Facts, not claims"; the build table is G2's), never from an executor's claim. Only a completed result with outcome found, empty or failed is reusable (13 [G2]); internal/graph checks that a reason fits its outcome (02).

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [ResultID](common-defs.md#resultid) | The identity of this output, minted by the controller for each output. It is never derived from the computation key. |
| `computation` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The ComputationKey.key this result answers. |
| `kind` | yes | [ResultKind](common-defs.md#resultkind) |  |
| `value` | yes | array of [ref](records-ref.md) | The output's content, by exact reference (10). Manifests list result ids, never keys (13). |
| `conclusions` | yes | null or object (open payload) | The typed projection used only for reuse decisions (13), one schema per result kind. Only gate and evidence results carry one, since conclusions-only equivalence exists only on the review←gate and review←evidence edges (13 "v1 scope"); every other kind has null. |
| `outcome` | yes | [Outcome](common-defs.md#outcome) |  |
| `reason` | yes | [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) |  |
| `detail` | yes | string (maxLength `4096`) | Non-empty for every outcome but empty (02 "Outcome"). |
| `completed` | yes | boolean | Whether execution observably completed: the executor reached a terminal result the controller accepted (05). An incomplete result is could_not_run, never empty (13 "Facts, not claims"). |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (4, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `outcome` any (not `empty`), `outcome` required, then `detail` any (minLength `1`)
- when `completed` `false`, `completed` required, then `outcome` `could_not_run`
- when `kind` `partial_patch`, `kind` required, then `completed` `false`
- when `kind` any (with a `not` constraint), `kind` required, then `conclusions` `null`
